rationale: The Latin anchor "veni separare hominem adversus patrem suum" (I came to set a man against his father) indicates an active, forceful splitting apart of persons — matching separate.v.02 ("force, take, or pull apart"), as in dividing people from one another. The quotation from Mt. 10:35 confirms this is a concrete act of causing separation between individuals rather than a spatial/barrier sense or a classificatory sense.
